text:
jess (design): Quick pass on dark-mode charts + code block syntax — want to converge before next release. Thoughts on swapping the green series for a warmer teal? Hexes below.

sam (frontend): Yup, I'm seeing current green ( #2ecc71 ) looks muddy against the midnight background at smaller sizes. Teal could improve legibility.

jess (design): Proposal: chart series order + colors — `#6DD3C7` (teal), `#6FA8FF` (blue), `#FFB86B` (amber), `#C9C1FF` (lavender). These keep saturation but increase contrast.

anne (product): Prefer the amber for error/reduced throughput markers? It reads as a warning color visually.

miguel (eng-ml): Agree on amber for regressions. Also for syntax highlighting: current inline code (pale yellow) becomes invisible on some monitors. Could we use stronger tokens for keywords vs strings?

jess (design): For syntax tokens I sketched a split: keywords `#9AB8FF`, strings `#A6E3C6`, functions `#F5C07B`, comments `#7C848C` (muted). Keeps contrast with dark bg.

sam (frontend): Can you paste the CSS var snippet? I can wire it into the theme switcher.

jess (design): Sure — quick snippet:
```css
:root[data-theme=\"dark\"] {
  --bg: #0b0f13;
  --surface-1: #0f1418;
  --text-main: #e6eef6;
  --code-keyword: #9AB8FF;
  --code-string: #A6E3C6;
  --chart-1: #6DD3C7;
  --chart-2: #6FA8FF;
  --chart-3: #FFB86B;
  --chart-4: #C9C1FF;
}
```

sam (frontend): That helps. I’ll run contrast checks. Quick note: `--text-main` at 0.9 full white gives a11y issues on some UI chips. Might need `#dbeaf5` instead.

jess (design): Good catch. I can nudge it down. Also want to update tooltip copy: change “Latency 95th” to “P95 latency” for consistency across charts. Small copy tweak.

anne (product): +1 for `P95 latency`. Also add a unit tooltip for embeddings (tokens vs vectors) — customers keep asking.

miguel (eng-ml): For chart lines, can we add a 1px low-opacity stroke for the teal/blue series to improve separation when lines overlap? e.g., `stroke: rgba(0,0,0,0.18)` behind the line.

sam (frontend): That should be doable. Will prototype with `mix-blend-mode` fallback too.

aria-bot: Accessibility check queued: contrast ratios will be evaluated, expect report in ~10m. :robot_face:

jess (design): If aria-bot flags anything, I’ll push updated swatches. Otherwise I’ll write the change log entry for the release notes: “Dark theme: chart and syntax color refresh, P95 copy tweak, improved tooltip units.”

sam (frontend): I’ll open a PR after the accessibility run. Ping me when the aria report is ready.

miguel (eng-ml): Also logging a tiny performance nit — the chart shader for glow needs to be disabled for low-end devices in dark mode (runs hotter). Can add a `prefers-reduced-motion` style to kill shader.

jess (design): Nice. I’ll add a quick sentence in the docs about `prefers-reduced-motion` and shader fallback.

anne (product): Thanks everyone — if the report is green we ship these in the next console push.

sam (frontend): noted. Will post the PR link here when ready.

aria-bot: Accessibility report: 3 items flagged — `--text-main` contrast (needs tweak), inline code background insufficient, and chart color pair `#6FA8FF` vs `#C9C1FF` low contrast at small stroke widths.

jess (design): Thanks bot. I’ll update `--text-main` to `#dbeaf5`, switch inline code bg to `#111418` and bump lavender to `#BFB3FF`. Will re-run.

sam (frontend): Once updated I’ll re-run the visual diffs.

miguel (eng-ml): Also suggest adding alt-friendly patterns for chart fill (diagonal hatch) for color-blind viewers on critical alerts. Small SVG pattern but effective.

jess (design): Good idea. I’ll mock a subtle hatch for the amber series and share assets in the PR.

anne (product): Awesome — this feels actionable. Thanks team.
